articles.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Tirana
articles.description: Thousands of students in Albania are calling for better university conditions and job prospects, but buildings have been set on fire in the unrest.

articles.title: Hundreds of thousands of workers on strike across Republic of Ireland
articles.description: It comes amidst an an ongoing pay dispute between public sector workers and the Irish government.

articles.title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
articles.description: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.

articles.title: Children killed in arson attack named - as family calls for culprit to 'own up'
articles.description: Two children who died in an arson attack at a home in Ireland have been named as Callum and Jayden, as their family and police urge anyone with information to come forward.
